mapper.sql: product_code AS productCode, product_version AS productVersion, product_name_zh_tw AS productName, product_type_code AS productTypeCode, CASE product_type_code WHEN 'I' THEN '投資型保險' ELSE '傳統型壽險' END AS productTypeDescription, coverage_item_type AS coverageItemType, currency_code AS currencyCode, product_risk_level_code AS productRiskLevelCode, minimum_entry_age AS minimumEntryAge, maximum_entry_age AS maximumEntryAge, minimum_sum_assured AS minimumSumAssured, maximum_sum_assured AS maximumSumAssured, minimum_premium AS minimumPremium, minimum_coverage_term_years AS minimumCoverageTermYears, maximum_coverage_term_years AS maximumCoverageTermYears, minimum_payment_term_years AS minimumPaymentTermYears, maximum_payment_term_years AS maximumPaymentTermYears, effective_from AS effectiveFrom, effective_to AS effectiveTo, CASE WHEN product_type_code = 'I' THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS investmentProduct ,created_by AS createdBy, created_at AS createdAt, updated_by AS updatedBy, updated_at AS updatedAt, reviewer_id AS reviewerId, reviewed_at AS reviewedAt
